about: Publishable units with no reviewed consumer recipe (scripts/preflight.mjs consumer-recipe and npm-recipe, G01). Every publishable crate and public npm package has a recipe or is listed here; a unit leaves this list in the commit that adds its recipe, and a unit about to publish must have one whatever this list says. Listed 2026-10-24 from the tree.
